provenance.note: Where the sediment enters the water, as a Point: the pick's {coordinates, name} verbatim, a (lon, lat) pair, 'lat,lon', a point layer. Geocode a place name first. Its name becomes the marker's name, and on a river with no domain supplied it is also the seed the reach is walked downstream from [supplied on this invocation]
Finite pulse injection window [supplied on this invocation]

Target element edge or cell length the domain is resolved at. The granularity is the USER's lever: no sizing rung derives an edge from a channel nobody surveyed, so the number the run meshes at is either yours or this labeled default [supplied on this invocation]
Along-domain release position, 0=inflow..1=outflow; the source must sit strictly INSIDE the domain, never on a boundary [declared scenario default]
Solve sizing class - how many cores the solve is partitioned across. An engine that runs on one core says so on the card [declared constant default]

Vertical datum this run counts every elevation from - the bed under it and the level over it. A source published on another frame reaches this one through a measured offset, and a pair nobody publishes an offset between refuses by name [declared constant default]

The mass the pulse released - the deck's own fixed discharge and concentration x spill_duration_s - which the deposited fraction is measured against [derived by trid3nt_server.workflows.telemac.helpers.released_mass.released_mass_kg]
not supplied; a surface is read at the most recent cycle its own source has published, and no series source is asked at all - a record is a reading at a time, and this run stated none
